scripts.preview: npm run build:preview && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs vite preview --config vite.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.deploy:preview: tsc -b && npm run build:preview && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: tsc -b && npm run build:production && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.types:cloudflare: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler types worker/env.d.ts --env preview --include-runtime false
scripts.types:check: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler types worker/env.d.ts --env preview --include-runtime false --check
scripts.check: npm run types:check && tsc -b && vitest run && npm run test:worker && npm run build:preview && npm run build:production
